Simplify Home recommendations and add a compact Shorts strip.

- Keep **For you** as the lead section with its featured video and nearby recommendations.
- Keep **More to explore** beneath For you, showing the rest of the Home video recommendations without splitting them into separate "Because you watched" sections.
- Remove **Live now** and **Channels to discover** recommendations from Home, including the extra network requests used to build those sections.
- Add a compact, horizontally scrollable **Shorts** row beneath More to explore. Portrait cards open the existing Shorts viewer, with next/previous navigation.
- Collect genuine YouTube Shorts recommendations using Shorts-specific search results, deduplicate them, and gracefully omit the row if no Shorts can be retrieved.
- Add regression tests covering Shorts mapping, malformed YouTube responses, and the exact three-section Home layout.

This update includes the playback authorization recovery added in v1.2.0.

Validation includes TypeScript checks, 38 core tests, desktop integration checks, packaged Linux smoke testing, and Windows/Linux builds.

Windows x64 and Linux x64 (AppImage/DEB) installers include source and automatic-update metadata. Windows installers remain unsigned. macOS packaging is disabled.
